turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! It's great that you have that to look forward to. And how are things at the high school? I hope leading the science department isn't taking up too much of your weekend.

turns.text: Fortunately, no. I got most of my grading and prep done on Friday, so I've been able to completely disconnect this weekend, which has been great.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. A true weekend off is hard to come by sometimes. Do you have any plans for how you'll spend the evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not much, just keeping it low-key. Grace and I will probably just watch some sitcom reruns on TV tonight and head to bed early.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sitcom reruns are the ultimate comfort television. Perfect for winding down a relaxing Sunday. I hope you have a great evening, Marcus!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'll talk to you later.
